awilix-async-container-initialization.reason: src/__tests__/rollup.test.ts requires ../../lib/awilix, the output of `npm run build`, which is not in the repository; the file cannot load in any checkout and jest reports no test for it, so the run's exit code and report disagree.

fastapi-implicit-head-options.reason: pyproject.toml makes every warning an error; uv.lock pins starlette 0.52.1 but the published image installs 1.2.1, which warns when it falls back to httpx, so collection fails before any test runs. Only that warning class is ignored.

prometheus-transactional-reload-status.reason: The published image warms and documents GOWORK=off go test ./cmd/prometheus as the offline test target for this task, with GOFLAGS=-mod=mod. Workspace mode rejects that image flag, and the broader go.work suite includes unrelated packages that fail to build offline. Its 2.5 GB warmed Go cache must be copied into writable temporary storage before testing the candidate checkout; the default 4 GB temporary filesystem ran out of room, while 8 GB produced 82 passing tests.

prometheus-typed-label-sorting.reason: The existing sort_by_label implementation and its tests live under promql. The whole go.work suite includes a tools-only module and unrelated packages that do not build offline in this image, so it produces no usable report. The promql package tree tests the task's candidate code directly.

returns-validated-error-accumulation.reason: setup.cfg injects pytest-cov and pytest-mypy command-line options, but the published image does not install those plugins. Those options make pytest exit during argument parsing before any tests run; clearing only addopts leaves the repository's test discovery and test code unchanged.
